ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these helps you speak fluently? (1 mark)
   A. Mumbling
   B. Practising what you want to say
   C. Speaking as fast as possible
   D. Never looking at the audience

2. What punctuation mark follows the greeting 'Dear Achieng'? (1 mark)
   A. A colon
   B. A comma
   C. A full stop
   D. A question mark

3. What does 'Haste makes waste' mean? (1 mark)
   A. If you hurry, you may make mistakes and waste things
   B. Hurry is always best
   C. Food is wasted at night
   D. Waste is good

4. Which sentence uses the past perfect? (1 mark)
   A. I had finished before he came.
   B. I am finishing.
   C. I finish.
   D. I have finished.

5. Language patterns: Which is correct? (1 mark)
   A. There is enough water to drink.
   B. There is enough water for drink.
   C. There enough is water to drink.
   D. There is water enough to drink.

6. Which sentence has a comma before 'but' joining two full sentences? (1 mark)
   A. I was tired but I finished sweeping,
   B. I was tired but, I finished sweeping.
   C. I was, tired but I finished sweeping.
   D. I was tired, but I finished sweeping.

7. Which word contains the blend 'tr'? (1 mark)
   A. snake
   B. clap
   C. flag
   D. train

8. Which preposition completes: 'The bank is ____ the school and the post office.'? (1 mark)
   A. between
   B. through
   C. among
   D. into

9. In 'listen', the silent letter is (1 mark)
   A. l
   B. n
   C. s
   D. t

10. Which helping verb completes: 'I ____ writing a letter now.'? (1 mark)
   A. was
   B. is
   C. am
   D. are

11. What does a smile usually show? (1 mark)
   A. Boredom
   B. Anger
   C. Fear
   D. Happiness or friendliness

12. Which sentence puts the comma after the opening phrase? (1 mark)
   A. In the morning we, do exercises.
   B. In the morning, we do exercises.
   C. In, the morning we do exercises.
   D. In the morning we do, exercises.

13. Choose the correct -ing form of 'run'. (1 mark)
   A. runeing
   B. runnning
   C. running
   D. runing

14. Choose the sentence with a superlative. (1 mark)
   A. Chege is taller than Ben.
   B. Chege is the tallest boy.
   C. Chege is tall.
   D. Chege is very tall than Ben.

15. Which is the correct order for the parts of a friendly letter? (1 mark)
   A. Address and date, greeting, body, closing, name
   B. Name, body, date, greeting
   C. Body, greeting, name, date
   D. Closing, address, body, greeting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe the steps to interpret a picture. (3 marks)

17. Give two pieces of advice for staying safe online. (3 marks)

18. Sort these adverbs into manner, time and place: quietly, later, nearby, always, neatly, upstairs. (3 marks)

19. Write two words with the sound /uː/ and two words with /ʊ/. (2 marks)

20. Write the comparative and superlative of: happy, beautiful. (2 marks)

21. Write two sentences using 'compose' and 'reply'. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Practising what you want to say
   Practice reduces hesitation.

2. B — A comma
   A comma follows the greeting.

3. A — If you hurry, you may make mistakes and waste things
   Rushing often leads to errors.

4. A — I had finished before he came.
   Had + past participle.

5. A — There is enough water to drink.
   Enough comes before the noun.

6. D — I was tired, but I finished sweeping.
   A comma comes before but when joining two full sentences.

7. D — train
   Train begins with t and r.

8. A — between
   'Between' is used for two things.

9. D — t
   We say lisn, so the t is silent.

10. C — am
   'I' takes 'am' in the present progressive.

11. D — Happiness or friendliness
   A smile shows a friendly feeling.

12. B — In the morning, we do exercises.
   A comma follows the opening phrase.

13. C — running
   Short verbs ending in one vowel and one consonant double the last letter.

14. B — Chege is the tallest boy.
   The tallest points to the top of three or more.

15. A — Address and date, greeting, body, closing, name
   This is the standard order.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the whole picture, read the caption, notice details and expressions, think what is happening and what will happen next.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three steps.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not give your name, school or address to strangers. Show worrying messages to a trusted adult. Ask a parent or teacher before opening a new page.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct piece of advice, up to 3.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Manner: quietly, neatly. Time: later, always. Place: nearby, upstairs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct group.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: /uː/: food, spoon. /ʊ/: book, cook.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: happier, happiest; more beautiful, most beautiful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: I will compose an email to my uncle. He will reply tomorrow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
